reasoning.text: Funding is at the normal baseline on all three venues: 0.0100% per 8h on Binance, Bybit and OKX. The source itself says about 0.01% is normal. When longs are heavily crowded, they usually pay a clearly higher funding rate. That isn't happening here.
Open interest is flat to slightly down: about $1.0B, -0.29% vs 1h ago and +0.66% vs 4h ago. No new leverage is piling in, long or short.
Forced liquidations were tiny and mostly hit shorts: 9 liquidations worth $51.8K, $38K shorts vs $13.9K longs. Nothing points to an overloaded long side being flushed.

caveats: The long/short ratios (1.62 all accounts, 2.19 top positions) clearly lean long. There's no history in the evidence to tell whether these levels are unusually high for SOL, so a milder claim like 'leaning long' would be supported.
Taker buy/sell data is missing (null), so current aggressive buying vs selling can't be checked.
Positioning ratios are from Binance only. Funding covers three venues, and liquidations cover OKX and Binance.
